description: VaMRT - a real-time, AI-driven NPC for VaM (prototype). NVIDIA ARDY generates her motion live from the Voxta conversation: "come here", "sit in that chair", "bend over and hold it" become real movement, not canned clips. VaMRT_Senses tells the AI what is in the room and where you are; VaMRT_Face drives expression, eye contact and head turns from her mood; the BVH Player (VaMRT build) streams the motion into VaM. This package is the VaM side: the three plugins and a wired demo scene. The motion model runs on your PC outside VaM - setup and the Voxta scenario are at the GitHub link.
credits: BVH Player: a modified build of ElkVR / VRAdultFun's BVH Player 1.1.3 (CC BY) - streaming reload, chunk blending, world travel, root follow, floor cap. Motion model: NVIDIA ARDY (code Apache-2.0, weights under the NVIDIA Open Model Agreement). ARDY-to-BVH converter: iremoztrk (Apache-2.0). 8-bit text encoder: the Voxta team. Expressions used by VaMRT_Face: AshAuryn and ascorad (Hub). Built on Voxta (AcidBubbles and the Voxta team) and VoxtaTouchElite (FutureStorm). VaMRT_Senses and VaMRT_Face: Gingersnap, MIT.
instructions: 1) Install this var. 2) PC side: get the repo at the link, run pc\setup.bat (installs ARDY, the converter and a conda environment; needs an NVIDIA GPU, Miniconda and Git). 3) Voxta: import voxta\scenario mood v43.json from the repo. 4) Load the scene VaMRT Demo, pick your Voxta character in the Voxta plugin, apply any look you like. 5) Run pc\Start_VaMRT.bat, then talk to her. Full guide: docs\INSTALL.md in the repo. Prototype - see docs\KNOWN_ISSUES.md for what is rough and where help is wanted.
